quote: Well, I would do an in person visit, not over the phone.

alternative_hypothesis: The transcript may be cut off before the rep responds; the objection could have been resolved off-transcript.
coaching_implication: Ensure button_up locks a specific date/time and channel before ending the call; this customer statement needed a direct answer.

quote: Why is you interested in solar?

coaching_implication: Spend more time validating the bill-pain reason before moving to mechanical qualifiers.
